### 0.1.494
- [#210](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/210) — #209 Added: per-PR summaries and native startup release notes — build +6
  <p>LeonardoMD shows the changes included in each new version at startup. You can hide the notice for that version or reopen it from the application menu.</p>
- [#213](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/213) — #208 Added: resize preview tables with persisted MDLF geometry — build +9
  <p>Resize columns, rows and whole tables in Preview with the mouse or keyboard. Markdown documents migrate safely to MDLF to preserve table dimensions.</p>
- [#221](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/221) — #220 Fixed: improve light-theme document indicator contrast — build +3
  <p>Improve document format and storage indicator contrast in light themes using the palette heading color.</p>
- Accepted evidence: [verified event](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/releases/tag/v0.1.494)

### 0.1.571
- [#229](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/229) — #228 Added: file list colors filtering and sorting — build +4
  <p>Distinguish Leonardo files in wine, configure file colors globally or per project, and filter and sort the project file list.</p>
- [#231](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/231) — #230 Added: document undo and redo history — build +4
  <p>Undo and redo document edits from the toolbar or keyboard, with separate history for each document and support for source, preview and form editing.</p>
- [#235](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/235) — #234 Fixed: preserve form presentation in Preview and Split — build +5
  <p>Preview and Split preserve the field presentation shown in Fill form.</p>
- [#237](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/237) — #236 Added: promote an exact beta without changing its version — build +2
  <p>Promote a chosen validated beta to stable while preserving its version and exact signed artifact, even when newer betas exist.</p>
- [#233](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/233) — #232 Fixed: enlarge form calendars and follow document themes — build +12
  <p>Form date fields offer a larger calendar in the active theme, with localized labels, keyboard navigation and a safe fallback for malformed locales, while preserving editable drafts.</p>
- [#217](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/217) — #216 Added: export Leonardo reading copies as Markdown — build +14
  <p>Export Leonardo documents and form answers as Markdown with a loss warning and portable image handling.</p>
- [#242](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/242) — #241 Fixed: move user deletions to Trash — build +12
  <p>Deleted files, folders and projects now move to Trash so they can be recovered.</p>
- [#250](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/250) — #249 Refactored: retire proprietary mobile Git — build +11
  <p>Little Leonardo becomes read-only, preserves older work against cache overwrites and exports it for recovery; proprietary Git is retired while desktop synchronization and system Git remain available.</p>
- [#248](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/248) — #247 Fixed: attach auxiliary windows and document dialogs as modal sheets — build +13
  <p>About, Release notes, confirmations and file selection attach as modal sheets; file actions reject changes to the active project or workspace.</p>
- Accepted evidence: [verified event](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/releases/tag/v0.1.571)

- [#328](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/328) — #324 Fixed: validate Sparkle dependencies and share QA signing — build +3
  <p>Local app launches now check bundled dependencies and signing consistency before opening; disposable QA copies share the distribution signing order to prevent Sparkle loading failures.</p>
- [#336](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/336) — #202 Fixed: install updates directly from Preferences — build +5
  <p>Install and relaunch updates directly from Preferences, preserving unsaved-document and Git safety checks.</p>
- [#344](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/344) — #340 Added: authorize rubric requests and responses — build +7
  <p>Adds protocol foundations for targeted Mac-to-iOS rubric requests without granting document editing. Capability negotiation, durable retries and pinned transport are ready; production UI/enrollment wiring remains deferred to #342.</p>
- [#338](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/338) — #337 Updated: organize synchronization by sharing and connecting roles — feature +1, build +17
  <p>Find sharing, device permissions and remote copies together in Synchronization, with separate pages for sharing from this Mac and connecting to other computers.</p>
- Accepted evidence: [verified event](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/releases/tag/v0.3.861)

### 0.3.1022
- [#349](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/349) — #341 Added: request and save a Little Leonardo rubric from macOS — build +37
  <p>macOS targets one explicitly capable linked read-only peer, recovers requests by stable ID, reviews returned rubrics, and saves or inserts them safely. Legacy peers remain unsupported until #342.</p>
- [#352](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/352) — #342 Added: iOS rubric capture flow — build +102
  <p>iOS captures rubrics requested by a linked Mac with explicit consent, durable drafts, preview and HTTPS retry. Interrupted acceptance recovers safely and revoked links stay blocked after restart. Guides and Mac consent are available in English and Spanish.</p>
- [#363](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/363) — #272 Fixed: preserve display math and require native help QA — build +10
  <p>Display formulas retain their TeX syntax, and both user guides include recurring math regression examples with mandatory help checks in tested app instances.</p>
- [#371](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/371) — #343 Added: package owner-only iOS distribution — build +7
  <p>Adds owner-only iOS archive/export and Apple validation with canonical versioning, privacy metadata and branded assets; binds archives to clean committed source, documents #367&#x27;s immutable rubric request identity, and keeps keychain signing process-scoped.</p>
- [#376](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/376) — #375 Update: blend help illustrations into Leonardo Classic — build +5
  <p>Help illustrations now blend into the document background with transparent Leonardo Classic artwork and localized captions, while new guide revisions preserve existing personal copies.</p>
- Accepted evidence: [verified event](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/releases/tag/v0.3.1022)

### 0.3.1136

  <p>Little Leonardo includes an offline bilingual demo with format examples and a locally saved practice form.</p>
- [#382](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/382) — #380 Added: expose bounded HTTPS failure diagnostics — build +25
  <p>Adds privacy-safe HTTPS diagnostics for iOS sync failures, preserving URL errors, pinning, redirects and bounds. A real TLS cutoff test checks partial byte counts; the alert and bilingual Guide v23 explain the code. Physical root cause remains unconfirmed.</p>

  <p>Little Leonardo uses Classic colors and branded startup, adds offline About, help, privacy and license pages, and expands rubric drawing in landscape while restoring portrait controls without changing the drawing.</p>
- [#392](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/392) — #380 Updated: complete TLS shutdown and trace response termination — build +14
  <p>Shared-project HTTPS responses finish the TLS write stream before teardown, with bounded cleanup and privacy-safe server completion diagnostics.</p>
- [#398](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/398) — #394 Fixed: recover rubric queries during helper configuration — build +9
  <p>Recover rubric status queries automatically while preserving request identity and access, and restore CI downloads with verified pinned Sparkle artifacts.</p>
